Hi,

I was playing around with formally verifying some parts of cranelift using AI, with minimal steering(every other day or so). So far two discrepancies have popped up when the AI was trying to create proofs.

One of them is this: https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasmtime/pull/14525 and the other is https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasmtime/pull/14526

Would be great to get some feedback on them. @bjorn3 has looked at the 14525, so potentially just focussing on that one since it has a higher chance of not being a false positive.

Thanks

(might have been better suited for #cranelift. looks like unlike the rust-lang instance, this zulip instance doesn't allow me to move messages between channels though, only moderators and up are allowed to)
